_readme: SpeakLoop light color scheme. Selected with 'color_theme': 'light' in config/settings.json; restart to apply. Keys starting with '_' are ignored. A missing key falls back to the built-in dark palette in speakloop/config.py, so every key of the dark scheme is answered here. Copy this file into config/themes/ to edit it without touching the installation.
_surfaces: Backgrounds and borders. bg_main (the window) is tinted slightly grey so the near-white chat panel reads as raised. bg_accent is the accent-tinted fill of the idle mic button.
_text: Same roles as in the dark scheme, inverted: dark text on light surfaces. text_bright is the strongest of them (the learner's own line), and the mic glyph is drawn in it on the pale mic fills below.
_status: Status line and mic outlines, darkened to stay readable on light surfaces.
_mic: Mic button per-state inner fill; the outlines reuse accent, bad, warn and good.
